reviewMethod: Visually inspected actual raw and full-resolution composited PNGs; not a calibrated perceptual score.

observations: Teal color transfers but stripes are extremely faint; the guard correctly rejected the output.
Teal and cream horizontal stripes now visibly transfer across torso and both short sleeves. Rounded neckline and hem are coherent, and no large original beige-shirt fragments remain.
Fine stripe count/spacing and collar shape differ from the synthetic reference. Fabric is smoother than a real product photo; a small armpit seam artifact remains in the original composite.
Original face, hair, hands, jeans, shoes and surrounding background are preserved.

different-person-anchored.verdict: rejected: shoulder silhouette and compositing mismatch
observations: Raw output has two sleeves and a recognizable black graphic shirt, unlike the prior sleeveless result.
The generated shoulders narrow relative to the original body. Final compositing preserves exposed skin caps and introduces bright wedges at the shoulders. This is not acceptable.
The new body-shape guard rejects substantial generated-background intrusion into original upper-arm skin, instead of erasing skin to hide the defect.
